description: Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission Ref: P0542.25 dated 21/10/25 to allow for reduction in width of approved pool outbuilding from 15.3m to 15.15m, new door opening to the rear and, side clearances of approximately 800mm to reflect existing fence lines on site (Demolition of existing house and erection of two-storey detached dwelling with accommodation in the roof with pool house in rear garden.)
decision_conditions: The amendments to the approved application listed below is considered to be of a minor nature and acceptable in its own right and not require resubmission of a fresh planning application;
1.	To allow for reduction in width of approved pool outbuilding from 15.3m to 15.15m, new door opening to the rear and, side clearances of approximately 800mm to reflect existing fence lines on site.

The applicant is advised that this amendment relates solely to the items detailed above and annotated on drawing labelled of 25-019/07F and not to any other deviation from the approved drawings. Furthermore, this amendment does not in any way alter or remove any previous conditions imposed on the original approved application reference P0542.25.
